paths.name: Core Developer Path
paths.description: Start with product planning, then work through APIs, AI, delivery, and frontend development.

paths.name: Full-Stack Product Delivery
paths.description: Build a feature from the API to the interface, then test it the way a real user would.

paths.name: Legacy System Modernization
paths.description: Read unfamiliar MUMPS, COBOL, and WCF systems, protect their behavior with tests, and replace them safely.

paths.name: Delivery and Operations Automation
paths.description: Replace repetitive delivery and operations work with tools your team can maintain.

paths.name: Cross-Functional Product Delivery
paths.description: Plan and ship one feature with product and engineering roles working together.

paths.name: AI and ML Capabilities
paths.description: Work with data, train a model, and build software that uses AI where it earns its place.

paths.name: Azure Platform Engineering
paths.description: Create Azure infrastructure your team can deploy again, review, and operate without guesswork.

paths.name: AI-Driven Development Acceleration
paths.description: Use agents and the Copilot SDK to shorten the path from a written requirement to working software.

paths.name: Secure Software Delivery
paths.description: Find release risks, fix the ones that matter, and add tests that keep them from coming back.

paths.name: Enterprise Architecture and API Platforms
paths.description: Make the architecture decisions behind shared APIs, then support them with clear Azure platform controls.
